messages.content: Extract compact predicate structure from the exact source unit. This is syntax/semantic-role acquisition, not a permission/prohibition/obligation classifier. Do not supply normative effect labels or answer a legal question. Include each predicate governing disclosure, return/destruction or retention and each such conduct predicate, including an embedded condition, lexical governor, exception, coordination and source references. predicate_quote is the exact lexical head word, excluding auxiliaries and negation. modal_quote is the exact modal auxiliary word such as shall or may, or empty if absent. negation_quote is an exact local negation cue, or empty; it belongs to the predicate actually negated, not automatically every embedded conduct. actor_quote/object_quote identify the actual role arguments as exact SOURCE substrings. Include information ownership and original copy quantifiers when stated. Do not invent an antecedent; unresolved roles are empty. All nonempty quotes must occur literally in this unit. Edges go from governing predicate to child. A condition is not a complement. For an archival exception the main obligation predicate is parent and retention is the exception child. Relation quote preserves the whole relevant qualifying clause including its marker, not just if/except. A reference such as exceptions provided elsewhere is reference, not a new permission. Do not create alternative false parses to populate a quota. Use unique local node IDs and omit nonexistent edges. Return only the schema object with nodes and edges. No native queries, answers or source feedback are supplied.
